glosses: worship (the devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object)
worship; ritual, rite (the religious ceremonies that express devotion)
cult (a group or sect of people with a deviant religious, philosophical or cultural identity)

examples.text: En EEUU, la libertad de culto es una de las garantías de la Carta de Derechos.
examples.en: In the U.S., freedom of religion is one of the guarantees of the Bill of Rights.
